description: This file is a shell script for managing Git submodules, providing commands for adding, initializing, updating, listing, and configuring submodules, as well as executing commands within submodules.

methods.name: cmd_add
methods.description: Adds a new submodule to the working tree, .gitmodules, and the index with various options.

methods.name: cmd_foreach
methods.description: Executes an arbitrary command sequence in each checked out submodule.

methods.name: cmd_deinit
methods.description: Unregisters submodules from .git/config and removes their work tree.

methods.name: cmd_update
methods.description: Updates each submodule path to the correct revision, using clone and checkout as needed.

methods.name: cmd_summary
methods.description: Shows commit summaries for submodules in index or working tree.

methods.name: cmd_status
methods.description: Lists all submodules, indicating their status relative to the checked out revision.

methods.name: cmd_sync
methods.description: Syncs remote URLs for submodules to match .gitmodules.

methods.name: cmd_absorbgitdirs
methods.description: Handles absorbing Git directories into the superproject.
